name: classconnect
description: ClassConnect — Online Learning Platform for Cameroon (SRS-CC-CM-001 v1.0)

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @classconnect/shared && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/db && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/api && npm-run-all --parallel dev:api dev:web
scripts.//build: The first step is not optional. A host that runs its own install command may install only part of this repository — Vercel's inferred one covered 739 of the lockfile's 1113 packages and left out every dependency of apps/api — and the build then fails with `Cannot find module '@nestjs/common'` on 160 lines, which reads like broken source rather than an unfinished install. `ensure-workspace-deps.mjs` checks four of apps/api's runtime dependencies and, only if they are absent, installs the full lockfile before anything is compiled. Where the install was complete it exits in milliseconds having done nothing.
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-workspace-deps.mjs && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/shared && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/db && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/api && npm run build --workspace @classconnect/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @classconnect/api && npm run test --workspace @classconnect/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.serverless.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.spec.json
